chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Rabīʿ al-Aṣamm, from Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥadhdhāʾ and Mālik ibn ʿAṭiyyah, both from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

If a man divorces his wife with one divorce during his illness, then remains in that illness until her waiting period ends, and then dies in that illness after the completion of the waiting period, then she inherits from him so long as she has not remarried. فإذا كانت she has remarried after the completion of the waiting period, then she does not inherit from him.

key_terms.اِنْقِضَاءِ: the completion or expiration of a legal period
key_terms.مَرَضِهِ: his illness, the state in which the divorce and later death occur

ai.seo_question: Does a woman divorced during her husband's illness still inherit from him after her ʿiddah ends?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a wife divorced by her husband during his terminal illness. Even after the completion of her ʿiddah, she still inherits from him if he dies from that same illness, provided that she has not remarried; remarriage prevents her inheritance.
